okDesc: All the permissions I need there are in place.
whyMissingPerm: The **{bot}** role is missing **{perms}** on the whole server.
fixPrivate:
To fix it:
1. Open the channel's settings → Permissions
2. Add the **{bot}** role
3. Allow **{perms}**
4. Run this check again
fixRoleBlock:
To fix it:
1. Open the channel's settings → Permissions
2. Find **{bot}** (or add it) and allow **{perms}**
3. Run this check again
fixMissingPerm:
To fix it:
1. Open Server Settings → Roles
2. Open **{bot}** and turn on **{perms}**
3. Run this check again
fixGone: To fix it: pick another channel for this feature, in the dashboard or with the command that set it.
whyWrongType: {channel} is a forum, a media channel or a category: I can't post messages there.
fixWrongType: To fix it: pick a text channel instead.
whyThreadLocked: This thread is locked, so only moderators can post in it.
fixThreadLocked: To fix it: unlock the thread, give the **{bot}** role **{perms}**, or pick another channel.
whyTimeout: **{bot}** is timed out on this server, so it can't send anything.
fixTimeout: To fix it: right-click **{bot}** in the member list and remove its timeout.
whyRefused: Discord refused the message even though my usual permissions look fine.
fixRefused:
To fix it:
1. Open the channel's settings → Permissions
2. Check that **{bot}** is allowed **View Channel**, **Send Messages**, **Embed Links** and **Attach Files**
3. Run this check again
alertFooterLog: Only people who can see this channel get this alert, at most once a day for this feature. Check again with {cmd}.
alertFooterDm: You get this because you own **{guild}** and I couldn't post in its log channel. At most once a day for this feature. Check again with {cmd} on the server.
alertFixedLine: Checked {when}. The next real post will confirm it.
alertMuted: Alerts for this feature are muted for 7 days. The dashboard still shows the problem.
alertAdminsOnly: Only the server owner and admins with Manage Server can use these buttons.
alertGuildGone: I'm no longer on that server.
alertUnavailable: This is unavailable right now. Try again in a moment.
setWarn: Saved, but I can't post in {channel} yet.
whySoft: **{perms}** is turned off for **{bot}** here, so its emojis show as plain text.
fixSoft: To fix it: channel settings → Permissions → **{bot}** → allow **{perms}**.
testMessage: 🧪 ARCHON test: I can post here. This message disappears in 10 seconds.
limitTitle: I can post in {channel}, with limits
allHintPrefix: Every channel I use here: {cmd} with the **all** option, or `{prefix}postcheck all`
allHintSlash: Every channel I use here: {cmd} with the **all** option
oneHintPrefix: One channel in detail: {cmd} with the **channel** option, or `{prefix}postcheck #channel`
oneHintSlash: One channel in detail: {cmd} with the **channel** option
noChannels: No channel is set up for ARCHON yet.
roleAbove: above ARCHON's role, so it can't give it out
adminsOnlyAll: Only admins with Manage Server can check every channel.

short.private: private channel, ARCHON is not in it
short.soft: {perms} is off: emojis show as text

lowRole: My role **{bot}** is under all {above} of your roles. I can post normally, but I can't give roles, time out, kick or ban anyone yet.
lowRoleFix: To fix it: Server Settings → Roles, then drag **{bot}** above the roles I should give (for example {roles}).
